At the northwest shore of the island of Rookgaard there's a unreachable small isle with a sword in a rock surrounded by fire (here (32101, 32086, 7)). Near this sword is a sign that reads:

You see a sign.
You read: Only the humble may touch the Sword of Fury


This is the Sword of Fury; although it's called that way, it is a simple Spike Sword. Many have wondered if this sword is obtainable. Many have tried, but failed, to lay hands on the Sword.

Perhaps what the sign says, "Only the humble may touch the Sword Of Fury.", is a cleverly placed message by CipSoft. Perhaps, upon seeing the message, a new player will behave him/her self, thus acting humble. Who knows if the Sword of Fury will ever be obtained? Perhaps the answer is right in front of our noses, waiting for us to lay hands on the legendary sword.

Rumors

  • There was a rumor that it was once obtainable by completing a contest. If there was a contest, it is now long over.
  • Rumors say the CipSoft team has given a Spike Sword to Rookgaard's first player to reach level 100, Sunrise, who would have done a favor for them, but this was never confirmed by him.
  • A little to the south of the Sword of Fury there is a mountain (here (32102, 32105, 7)) with two floors and no stairs or ladders (although it's possible to reach them stacking items like parcels). At the second floor there is a lonely minotaur near a fire. It's said to have a connection with the Sword.
  • At the second floor of Tom's shop there is a hidden lever under a bucket in a locked room and next to the Goblin Temple Quest, there are two unreachable levers found in locked rooms. Some people say they have some kind of connection with the Sword of Fury.
  • At the west shore of northern Rookgaard, near some orcs and an orc spearman, there's some kind of ritual rock area (here (31983, 32136, 7)) with a daily spawn of a pile of bones of a dead wolf. It is rumored that these bones have a connection with the Sword.

Connections

Avar Tar

NPC Avar Tar claims the Sword of Fury was his sword and he left it there before leaving to the mainland.

Bozo & Maze of fury

At the south of the premium side of Rookgaard there is a grave (here (32009, 32232, 7)) that leads to a cave, the sign next to it says:

You see a sign.
You read: Bozo
Jester and escape artist


The cave under that grave leads to another cave, with skeletons, and a sign (here (32013, 32235, 9)) next to a collapsed tunnel that says:

You see a sign.
You read: Maze of fury


According to unoffcial maps, there's nothing below nor above the hole at the end of that collapsed tunnel.

Bozo is a Royal Jester from Thais and a known prankster. If asked about weapons he can sell you the Mace of the Fury (a simple and useless rolling pin).

Cipfried

When you ask Cipfried about his job, he says that he is just a humble monk. The sign by the island says that only the humble may touch the sword of fury. Also, the portal in the minotaur hell room is believed to be linked to the quest, and it has been shown to just lead back to the temple, where Cipfried is located.

Disappearing

Sometimes the sword will disappear from the island until server save and the fires on the surrounding rocks will die down. This is triggered without notice (which explains why people thought it was random).

Eclo on rook, a player from Antica, figured out how to make the Sword of Fury disappear from its place. He does not have the sword however, and if he did he would "never stop bragging about it." He proved he knows how to delete it by doing that on the 20th of January 2007 in 3 worlds, Harmonia, Luminera and finally Antica.

How to make Sword of Fury disappear:
As far as we know, when this trick is performed, the sword will simply disappear from the island. Around the 7.7 update, through less-than-honest means that will not be further mentioned here, it was been proven beyond all reasonable doubt that the sword will not be teleported or recreated elsewhere.
Needless to say, there's nothing saying that CipSoft can't change their own quests like they did with the Femor Hills tower, although it's not very likely considering the sword would unbalance rook completely.

Screenshot Taken the Moment the Sword Disappears [1]

To make the sword disappear, you need to step on two map fields in two different caves. First you need to step on a field on the northern part of this Poison Spider cave, on this (32065, 32068, 10) exact field.
After that, you need to step on a field adjacent to the southern wall of Rotworm Hell, the exact location is here (32169, 32158, 8).
Red Sparkles Effect will be seen when Sword of Fury disappears.
